cases.note: Deliberate: a recovered flattened source preserved in _archive beside the refined implementation derived from it. The structural match is the provenance link this archive exists to keep, not copy-paste to be merged. Merging them would destroy the record.

Deliberate: eddp-core-engine-v1 and -v2-refined are two preserved revisions of the same engine. Structural similarity between a revision and its successor is expected and is the point of keeping both.

Deliberate: compute_stable_hash is a general-purpose utility and target_object is its contract; val_data is one caller's local, holding validated pipeline data. They are names at two levels of abstraction that happen to meet at a single call site, not one value under two names. Renaming the parameter to val_data would import a caller's vocabulary into a utility that serves other callers; renaming the local to target_object would lose what it holds. Both names stay.
